text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a one-hour maximum parking regulation that would operate on the east side of Heward Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue. This parking proposal should discourage long-term daytime parking, and promote parking turnover on this section of Heward Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Heward Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue.
